title: Prepare this project for a fresh chat
summary: Memory harness works and holds the agreement; detailed organization is partial. Skills is a sample in review. The app has not been proven on a real JD. Lohith requested a clear five-point orientation and a specific decision before more component work.
body:

Current user-facing review point: explain project context and present one plain decision on the next priority. Do not start Canonical until Lohith responds to that decision. The previous Skills sample is committed but not accepted.
